items.title: Leidos Shares Jump After Strong Second-Quarter Results and Higher Full-Year Guidance
items.summary: Leidos Holdings Inc. (NYSE:LDOS) reported second-quarter 2026 results that comfortably exceeded Wall Street expectations, prompting the defence and technology contractor to raise its financial outlook for the full year.

items.title: Leidos (LDOS) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: Leidos (LDOS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +12.41% and +4.50%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Leidos (NYSE:LDOS) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations, Stock Soars
items.summary: Defense contractor Leidos (NYSE:LDOS) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.2% year on year to $4.56 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $18.3 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.26 per share was 12.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
